note: Smallest public EEG source (16 MB, 1 subject, EEGLAB .set). Baseline exemplar: cheapest full publish/DOI/manifest round trip. No zarr stores built upstream, so it exercises the no-zarr rendering path.

Smallest MEG source that actually converts (2343 MB, 3 zarr stores, 0 failures). The smaller on004398 (1309 MB) is CTF, which biosigIO cannot read: its zarr index reports store_count 0, so it would never render in the viewer.
Smallest iEEG source that converts (285 MB, 14 zarr stores, 0 failures). The smaller on006392 (32 MB) is a proprietary .tdat/.tidx/.tmet format with store_count 0.
Smallest public EMG source (447 MB, 11 zarr stores). Native nm dataset, so it also covers the nm-sourced clone path alongside the on-sourced entries.
HED-annotated exemplar (20 MB, HED 8.4.0, 20 zarr stores). Drives has_hed=1 and the ?has_hed=1 catalog filter on staging.
Second native EEG exemplar (22 MB, HED 8.4.0, 5 zarr stores). Small enough to be the default target for repeated update-cycle and re-publish testing.
Multi-modal exemplar (521 MB, beh+eeg, 60 zarr stores). Covers modality-array rendering and search facets, and produces a large enough archive to exercise the zip path.
